title: Coupled Restart / Split-Run / Replay Composition

scope.primary: Committed-only coupled SWAP-groundwater restart, true process split-run continuation and replay-safe restoration at an accepted coupling boundary.

implemented_contract.swap_committed_state: Reuses the existing kernel committed persistence contract and reconstructs/restores only committed physical continuation.
implemented_contract.groundwater_backend_state: Uses a separate opt-in serialization-neutral restart adapter bound by runtime/coupler composition to the same groundwater backend.
implemented_contract.mass_ledger: Persists committed interface exchange totals and diagnostic discard count only; active trial/prepared state is rejected and never persisted.
implemented_contract.coupling_origin: Persists accepted coupling provenance and requires exact SWAP, groundwater and accepted-time consistency.
implemented_contract.service_quiescence: Export and restore require zero live wrapper-level prepared reservations through groundwater_preparable_exchange_service_t%restart_quiescent().
implemented_contract.restore_publication_rule: All recoverable validation precedes backend restore publication. After adapter success, any violated checkpoint/provenance/quiescence postcondition is fail-hard rather than exposing a recoverable partially restored composition.

negative_and_failure_coverage: active ledger transaction rejects restart export
live prepared groundwater reservation rejects restart export/restore
tampered coupled provenance is rejected before external restore publication
adapter restore rejection leaves local SWAP/ledger/origin unpublished
stale candidate/pending trial state is absent after true-process restore
successful adapter restore with violated quiescence/checkpoint/provenance postcondition terminates fail-hard

architecture_invariants.1_single_kernel: PASS: reuses canonical kernel persistence rather than creating a coupled SWAP kernel.
architecture_invariants.2_kernel_separate_from_io: PASS: runtime record is typed and serialization-neutral; external process serialization exists only in the qualification test adapter.
architecture_invariants.3_explicit_data_separation: PASS: SWAP committed state, groundwater continuation, ledger and coupling provenance remain distinct typed carriers.
architecture_invariants.4_compact_persistent_state: PASS: committed continuation only; transient tokens and scratch are excluded.
architecture_invariants.5_scratch_per_worker: PASS: no solver scratch is persisted.
architecture_invariants.6_scalable_memory_layout: PASS: restart capability is opt-in and no per-column heavy solver object is introduced.
architecture_invariants.7_transactional_timesteps: PASS: restart is permitted only at quiescent accepted boundaries; active trial/prepared state fails closed.
architecture_invariants.8_cheap_recalculation_warm_start: PASS: physical continuation is restored without treating stale trial data as committed state.
architecture_invariants.9_generic_time: PASS: accepted_time is generic real time; no day/month/year semantics are introduced.
architecture_invariants.10_flexible_coupling_windows: PASS: continuation is bound to accepted coupling origin/time, not midnight windows.
architecture_invariants.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS: restart composes SWAP state, groundwater state, interface ledger and coupling provenance transactionally.
architecture_invariants.12_explicit_groundwater_interface_contra: PASS_WITH_EXISTING_AUTHORITY: F-GC24 does not alter head/flux interface semantics and preserves the accepted coupling lineage.
architecture_invariants.13_mass_conservation_absolute: PASS: committed interface ledger is persisted/restored; active transactions are rejected; continuous and split signatures are identical.
architecture_invariants.14_interface_sensitivities_first_class: UNAFFECTED: no tangent semantics are changed or persisted as physical state.
architecture_invariants.15_limit_coupling_cost: UNAFFECTED: restart adds no required predictor/corrector reruns.
architecture_invariants.16_multiswap_primary: PASS_BY_ARCHITECTURE: persistence remains compact and opt-in; no one-solver-per-column requirement is added. Dedicated F-GC25 scaling qualification remains separate.
architecture_invariants.17_no_mandatory_1_to_1_modflow: UNAFFECTED: no MODFLOW cell/tile mapping assumption is introduced.
architecture_invariants.18_deep_vadose_optional_external: UNAFFECTED: no deep-vadose semantics are introduced into SWAP.
architecture_invariants.19_mass_conserving_component_transition: UNAFFECTED: this workunit does not define deep-vadose/direct-coupling transition policy.
architecture_invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: PASS: restart depends on kernel transaction_state_t/persistence boundary, not HeadCalc internals.
architecture_invariants.21_reuse_swap_physics: PASS: no duplicate groundwater-specific SWAP physics path is created.
architecture_invariants.22_no_headcalc_internal_coupling: PASS: no HeadCalc arrays or internals are referenced.
architecture_invariants.23_physics_options_vs_solver_policy: PASS: no physical option is silently changed by restart policy.
architecture_invariants.24_predictable_compute_time: UNAFFECTED: no fallback or solver-cost policy is changed.
architecture_invariants.25_reference_mode_available: UNAFFECTED: reference solver availability is unchanged.
architecture_invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS_WITH_SCOPE: ledger diagnostics and provenance survive restart; broader runtime diagnostics remain owned elsewhere.
architecture_invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PASS: restart adapter/state exists only for coupled restart-capable compositions.
architecture_invariants.28_runtime_coupler_system_composition: PASS: exchange service and persistence adapter are separately composed outside the kernel.
architecture_invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS: no .swp, path, calendar, midnight or direct-MODFLOW dependency is added.
architecture_invariants.30_every_architecture_change_checked: PASS: this authority records explicit invariant disposition for all 30 invariants.
